failure.name: ODT menu export retains authored content and annotation privacy
failure.expected: fo:break-before="column" on the paragraph imported from an authored leading run-level w:br type=column
failure.actual: No break-before property; imported inline column break exported only as an advisory soft-page-break
failure.finding: Valid DOCX run-level breaks become WmlBreak inlines without setting paragraph.columnBreakBefore. The layout handles both representations; the ODT writer only used the property for a real break. This requires a canonical import/export correction, not a relaxed host assertion.
